DIAGNOSIS READY: Polycythemia Vera (with secondary erythrocytosis and thrombocytosis).

Your blood tests show significantly elevated platelets and abnormal platelet shapes, which contradicts the low platelet count seen in iron deficiency anemia. Given your symptoms of digital pain improving with cold and a history of smoking, this strongly suggests a myeloproliferative neoplasm. I recommend a complete blood count with red cell mass measurement and JAK2 mutation testing to confirm.
